source_title: Fallout: Maximus Officially Announced for Next Year - GameRant
source_excerpt:
A new release called Fallout: Maximus is joining the franchise in 2027, alongside everything else in the works. Bethesda has several projects in development, including remasters of Fallout 3 and Fallout: New Vegas , while Fallout 76 is getting a major expansion called Raven Rock next year. Fallout 5 is in preproduction at Bethesda, and Fallout: New Vegas developer Obsidian is also working on another game in the franchise, but neither project has a confirmed release date.
The future of Fallout is looking particularly busy across both games and television. Amazon's acclaimed live-action series has already released two seasons, with Fallout Season 3 filming underway. As the television series continues to expand the wasteland's audience, there are plenty of ways to connect the show to the games (like merch).
Fallout: Maximus Officially Hits Sometime in 2027
Pre-Order Fallout: Maximus Ahead of Its 2027 Release
Now, Prime 1 Studio has revealed Fallout: Maximu s, a new quarter-scale Power Armor statue based on Amazon's television adaptation, with prices reaching $1,599. The collectible recreates the T-60 Power Armor worn by the Fallout show's Maximus and is available for pre-order ahead of an estimated shipping window of August-November 2027. The regular edition costs $1,399, while the Deluxe Bonus Edition is priced at $1,599. The latter includes additional display options, although whether it's worth $200 more is up to the consumer.
Find the odd one out before the timer hits zero.
The statue features a detailed recreation of Maximus' T-60 Power Armor in Fallout , complete with the three distinctive claw marks and an illuminated headlight. Its wasteland-themed base includes a Deathclaw skull, Radroaches, and a milk vending machine, drawing directly from the imagery of the Fallout show. The collectible stands approximately 26.4 inches tall and weighs around 59.5 pounds, making it a substantial display piece. Prime 1 Studio has also included several interchangeable components, allowing collectors to change Maximus' appearance and equipment without purchasing an entirely different statue.
The $1,599 Deluxe Bonus Edition includes two interchangeable heads, allowing Maximus to appear with or without his helmet, alongside different arm configurations featuring fists and an assault rifle. It also comes with a separate head display stand and an exclusive right arm holding a T-60 pistol, referencing memorable confrontations from the television series. The Deluxe Bonus Edition is limited to 100 pieces according to the current listing, while Prime 1 Studio is accepting pre-orders for both versions. The company has previously released collectibles based on Lucy MacLean and the Ghoul, making Maximus another addition to its growing Fallout television lineup.
Of course, the price means Fallout: Maximus is aimed squarely at serious collectors, particularly those who have become attached to the Brotherhood of Steel character through Amazon's adaptation. Its 2027 release also coincides with what should be another important year for the franchise, even if fans are still waiting to learn more about Obsidian's mysterious Fallout game as well as the eventual mainline release of Fallout 5 .
